The tour comes in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and all driving and logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus entry to both temples); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (those entrance fees plus a midday meal).
